declarations.name: AuiRouterNav
declarations.description:
Router navigation for an AbsoluteUI navigation component: `<aui-sidebar auiRouterNav [items]="items">`
with items such as `{ id: 'people', label: 'People', routerLink: '/people' }`.
declarations.selector: aui-sidebar[auiRouterNav], aui-breadcrumb[auiRouterNav], aui-stepper[auiRouterNav], aui-tabs[auiRouterNav], aui-menu-bar[auiRouterNav], button[auiMenu][auiRouterNav]

types.name: AuiRouterTarget
types.description: Router fields an item, step, or tab may carry (in addition to its own fields).

types.name: AuiRouterItem
types.description:
An item type with optional router fields, nested `items` included, e.g.
`AuiRouterItem<SidebarItem>`, `AuiRouterItem<MenuItem>`, `AuiRouterItem<StepperStep>`.
